description: This file defines the 'StreamedSnapshot' class, which represents a serializable message for streamed snapshots, including methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and object comparison.

classes.name: StreamedSnapshot
classes.description: A final class implementing StreamingMessage and Jsonifiable, representing a streamed snapshot with entity ID and JSON snapshot data.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new StreamedSnapshot instance from an entity ID and snapshot JSON object.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a StreamedSnapshot object from a JSON object.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with the snapshot.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the StreamedSnapshot to a JSON object.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on entity ID and snapshot.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on entity ID and snapshot for object hashing.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the object.
